scope: Synthetic strict processed intervals; equivalent decisions checked at reachable stages and all opposite-fractal pairs. Not a production run, source-code change, or proof by testing alone.

safe_reductions.all_pair_intervals: Implied by strict endpoint fractals plus both range extrema
safe_reductions.initial: Known chronological/opposite branch; gap plus candidate-end range extremum; start-side follows initialization invariant
safe_reductions.extension: Reject weaker; gap already satisfied; check both bounds only on (old_endpoint,new_endpoint]
safe_reductions.reverse: Gap plus BOTH full-range extrema; neither side may be assumed valid

counterexamples.dropping_reverse_start_bound: 21bar pair9→19: internal top15 exceeds starting top9
counterexamples.dropping_reverse_end_bound: 15bar pair5→13: internal bottom7 is below ending bottom13

targeted_interval_rule: high=low+1; sequence numbers denote merged-center indices
